title: CRM Manager (m/w/d) - Vor Ort/Home-Office
description: Wir bei Inkster schreiben Eigenverantwortlichkeit, Motivation und Spaß groß! Als 10-köpfiges Team aus Digital Natives und unserem einzigartigen 2-Wochen Tattoo auf Fruchtbasis sind wir im Juni 2021 gestartet und innerhalb weniger Monate zum Europamarktführer aufgestiegen. Heute verkaufen wir unsere Produkte in sechs internationalen Märkten und arbeiten täglich daran, Inkster als moderne Love-Brand weiter auszubauen. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort eine/n CRM Managerin:in. Du begeisterst dich für Customer Experience, CRM und datengetriebenes Marketing? Gleichzeitig hast du Spaß daran, kreative Kampagnen, Newsletter und neue Ideen zu entwickeln? In dieser Rolle verbindest du analytisches Denken mit kreativem Arbeiten: Du analysierst Daten, verstehst unsere Kund:innen und entwickelst daraus Maßnahmen, die unsere Customer Journey, Kundenbindung und Kundenzufriedenheit nachhaltig verbessern. Von E-Mail-Marketing über Automatisierungen gestaltest du das gesamte Erlebnis unserer Bestandskund:innen aktiv mit. Du wirst als Vollzeitkraft ein wichtiger Teil unseres Teams, arbeitest eng mit den Foundern zusammen und erhältst viel Verantwortung ab Tag 1. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir unsere Kundenkommunikation kontinuierlich weiter, optimieren die Customer Experience und bauen Inkster als internationale Love-Brand weiter aus. Wir freuen uns auf dich. Aufgaben Du planst, erstellst und optimierst kreative E-Mail- und SMS-Kampagnen entlang der gesamten Customer Journey. Du entwickelst neue Automationen und Customer Flows, wertest deren Performance aus und optimierst sie kontinuierlich anhand relevanter KPIs. Du analysierst das Verhalten unserer Kund:innen und leitest daraus neue Ideen für CRM-Kampagnen, Customer Journeys und Retention-Maßnahmen ab. Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit unserem Customer Support die Qualität unserer Kundenkommunikation und stellst sicher, dass unsere Support Agents und AI-Systeme jederzeit auf dem neuesten Stand sind. Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Kundenanliegen und entwickelst Prozesse, Inhalte und Lösungen, um die Customer Experience kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Du analysierst Kennzahlen wie Wiederkaufrate, Customer Lifetime Value, Trustpilot-Bewertungen und Kundenzufriedenheit und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab. Du arbeitest eng mit Performance Marketing, Design, Content und Produktentwicklung zusammen und bringst Kundenfeedback in neue Kampagnen, Produkte und Prozesse ein. Qualifikation Du hast Erfahrung im CRM-, Customer Experience-, Customer Success- oder E-Mail-Marketing – idealerweise im E-Commerce oder bei einer D2C-Brand. Du kombinierst analytisches Denken mit Kreativität und findest sowohl in Zahlen als auch in der Kommunikation Optimierungspotenziale. Du hast ein starkes Gespür für modernes Design, Ästhetik, Branding und visuelle Kommunikation. Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis für Customer Journeys und weißt, wie man Kund:innen langfristig begeistert und bindet. Idealerweise hast du bereits mit CRM-Tools wie Klaviyo (Photoshop, Canva, o.ä.) sowie Helpdesk-Lösungen wie Gorgias, Zendesk oder ähnlichen Systemen gearbeitet. Du arbeitest organisiert, eigenverantwortlich und pragmatisch und setzt Projekte zuverlässig um. Du hast Freude daran, Prozesse zu verbessern, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und moderne KI-Tools sinnvoll einzusetzen. Du besitzt sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Benefits Ausstattung mit neuen Apple Geräten Viel kreative Freiheit und Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag Direkten Einfluss auf eine schnell wachsende internationale Love-Brand Flexible Arbeitsweise mit Office in Hamburg und Home-Office-Möglichkeit Ein junges, motiviertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen Die Möglichkeit, deine Arbeit direkt sichtbar zu machen Tiefe Einblicke in die Wachstumsstrategie eines modernen E-Commerce-Unternehmens Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Sie suchen eine positive berufliche Veränderung? Sie möchten den nächsten Schritt in Ihrer Karriere gehen und streben möglicherweise sogar eine Partnerschaft in einer zukunftsorientierten Kanzlei an? Sie möchten endlich wieder in einem positiven Arbeitsumfeld arbeiten, in dem Sie finanziell und persönlich wertgeschätzt werden? Sie suchen nach Tätigkeiten, die Sie auch wirklich weiterbringen?

Sofern Sie sich in mindestens einem der genannten Punkte wiederfinden, sollten Sie sich bei uns melden. Wir haben die attraktivsten Arbeitgeber der Steuerberatungsbranche in unserem Netzwerk und bringen zusammen, was zusammengehört. Grenzenlose Entwicklungschancen mit Partnermöglichkeiten, vielschichtige Tätigkeitsbereiche, Gehälter wie in der Industrie und vieles mehr – melden Sie sich bei uns und wir unterstützen Sie auf Ihrem weiteren Karriereweg!

Derzeit suchen wir nach einem Steuerberater (m/w/d) für eine unserer Partner-Kanzleien in Jena

Bei Rückfragen kannst du dich gerne jederzeit (auch nach deinem Feierabend) direkt telefonisch an Herrn Becker-Koch über folgende Nummer wenden: 015901431130

Aufgaben

Wir bringen zusammen, was zusammengehört. Dabei spielt das passende Tätigkeitsprofil natürlich eine entscheidende Rolle. Bei unserer Partnerkanzlei können Sie sich Ihren Aufgabenbereich auf Basis Ihrer persönlichen Stärken und Schwächen selbst zusammenstellen.

  • Erstellung und Review von Jahresabschlüssen
  • Erstellung von Steuererklärungen für Personen- und Kapitalgesellschaften
  • Steuerliche Sonderberatungsprojekte auf Basis individueller QualifikationenB. in den Bereichen der Erbschaftsteuer oder des Umwandlungssteuerrechts
  • Begleitung von Betriebsprüfungen
  • Teamleitung und Personalverantwortung (optional)
  • Weitere individuell wählbare Tätigkeitsbereiche, die Ihnen Freude bringen

Qualifikation

Am Ende sollte es für beide Seiten passen. Deshalb wäre es gut, wenn Sie sich in den folgenden Punkten wiederfinden.

  • Kommunikative Art und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten
  • Sorgfältige, effiziente und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
  • Offen für eine digitale Arbeitsweise
  • Führungsverständnis und Verantwortungsbewusstsein gegenüber Mitarbeitern (optional)
  • Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Steuerberaterexamen
  • Leidenschaft für steuerliche Themen

Benefits

Sie haben genug von 0815 Benefits, von denen Sie nicht wirklich profitieren? Dann sollten Sie einen Blick auf die nachfolgenden Benefits werfen.

  • Außerordentliche Vergütung von 90.000 € bis 130.000 € / Jahr, auf Wunsch auch Partnerperspektive
  • Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeiten sowie die Option auf Home-Office
  • Nettolohnoptimierung mit monatlichen 50,00€ Sachbezugsgutscheinen
  • Umfangreiche Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen wie z.B. Fachberater Qualifikationen
  • Modernste Ausstattung mit digitalen Prozessen
  • Starker Teamzusammenhalt und regelmäßige Teamevents

Schnell, unkompliziert und effizient Ihren Traumjob finden – ein Versprechen an Sie, dass wir aufgrund unseres selektiven, breit gefächerten und deutschlandweiten Kanzleinetzwerks halten werden. lhre Vorteile mit uns auf einen Blick:

  • Sie führen keine unsinnigen Bewerbungsgespräche mehr, bei denen Sie während des Bewerbungsprozesses merken, dass es (bspw. wegen des Gehalts) sowieso nicht passt - wir klären vor Ihrem Bewerbungsgespräch all Ihre mit uns besprochenen Kriterien mit der Kanzlei ab.
  • Wir führen Ihre Gehaltsverhandlungen und kennen die Gehaltsstrukturen der Branche dabei bestens.
  • 100% Anonymität – solange Sie uns nicht das „Go“ geben und einem Kennenlernen mit Ihrem neuen potentiellen Arbeitgeber zustimmen, erfährt niemand von Ihrem Namen oder Ihren bisherigen Arbeitgebern – Ihre Ihnen wichtigen Kriterien können wir auch zunächst anonym mit unseren Partnerkanzleien klären.
  • Attraktive Kanzleien – die Kanzleien in unserem breit gefächerten Kanzleinetzwerk sind selektiv ausgewählt und heben sich klar von “normalen” Kanzleien ab (z.B. hinsichtlich der Vergütung, Benefits, Hierarchien, Digitalisierungsgrad, Ausstattung etc.).
  • Und das Beste: Unser gesamter Service ist unverbindlich und völlig kostenfrei für Sie.

In this high-impact role, you will shape go-to-market strategy, build strategic relationships, and win key deals with government stakeholders and procurement entities. You act as a true market builder — combining strategic business development with hands-on execution in a fast-moving and highly relevant sector. This role offers the opportunity to directly influence how cutting-edge unmanned systems are adopted across one of Europe’s most internationally connected defense landscapes. Establish and expand strategic alliances within the governmental and defense sector to position our product portfolio with key stakeholders. Conduct continuous business development and acquisition through country-specific research and your professional network. Build and maintain strong B2G network and sourcing relationships within your assigned markets. Act as Key Account Manager for strategic customers in Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg. Manage day-to-day sales operations, including CRM maintenance and proposal development together with our Bid and Solution teams. Create customer‑specific marketing content (e.g., whitepapers, solution briefs, use cases) in collaboration with Marketing and Product. Serve as the first point of contact for all sales-related inquiries within your field of expertise. Monitor market trends and competitors to anticipate opportunities and risks. Plan, coordinate, and conduct sales‑driving activities such as customer events and flight demonstrations. A strong drive to win new business and proactively develop a healthy sales pipeline. Ability to lead customer events, deliver compelling presentations, and professionally represent the company. Fluency in English; Dutch and/or French are a strong plus Willingness to travel up to 50%. Bonus: An established network within the BeNeLux governmental or defense procurement community. Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance. Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors. Our commitment: We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success. raw.description:
About SugarAI UK Limited

SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI.

We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next.

More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference.

Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done.

If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you.

Where You Fit In: 
SugarAI ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality. 

This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck. 

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

This role operates on a hybrid model, with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration at our Solihull location, specifically, working in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.

 

Disclaimer: When applying to this job posting, you are submitting your application for consideration of a role which may or may not actually exist, or be available now or in the future. Application submission is agreeing to be added to our Applicant Tracking System database, so we have the potential to surface your profile and reach out to you in the future, for opportunities which appear to be aligned to your background, experience or network.
 
To be considered for a specific job opening, please check out our Careers Page and apply to an active job posting. 

Impact You Will Make in the Role (Key Responsibilities): 

Agentic Development Systems 

  • Work from executable specifications — write clear SDD/BDD specs and acceptance criteria as the primary input for AI-assisted code generation, and keep them current as implementation evolves 

  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, from spec to implementation to test generation to code review 

  • Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality 

  • Contribute to the team's agentic development practices: spec standards, attestation norms, and how the team uses AI tools responsibly 

Feature Delivery 

  • Design, implement, and ship features and components that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high volume, high-availability SaaS environments 

  • Ensure agentic code is clean, well tested, and follows the standards that make it easy to understand and extend by both agentic systems and your teammates 

  • Own your feature areas end-to-end, from understanding the requirement to production delivery, including identifying and resolving defects before they reach customers 

Code Quality & Review 

  • Review outputs, including AI-generated code and agentic attestations, with the care and rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses 

  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behaviour, not just execution paths; apply the same critical eye to test quality as to production code 

  • Contribute to the team's technical standards and raise the bar on engineering operations excellence across all facets of our AI SDLC 

Collaboration & Systems Thinking 

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing 

  • Think beyond your immediate feature: understand the systems your code interacts with, the data it produces, and the downstream effects of your design decisions 

  • Communicate clearly in writing in specs, in code reviews, in async updatesto keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned 

  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations 


What You Will Bring (Qualifications/Experience): 

  • 2–5 years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments 

  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment 

  • Hands-on experience with BDD/SDD frameworks and working from executable specifications as the primary input to development, this is how we work, not a practice you're learning on the job 

  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or modern SaaS language; comfort picking up new languages and frameworks as the work demands 

  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption 

  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores 

  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end) 

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines 

  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team 


Preferred Qualifications/Experience: 

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent) and microservices architectures 

  • Familiarity with containerization, infrastructure-as-code, or observability tooling 

  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product 

  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology 

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. We want you to learn new things in this role, and we encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for. We also know that diversity of background and thought makes for better problem solving and more creative thinking, which is why we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
 
Benefits and Perks:
Beyond a stellar work environment, friendly people, and inspiring work, we have some sweet benefits and perks:
 
·       UK Pension Scheme
·       Private medical and dental insurance
·       Health &Wellness Reimbursement Program
·       Unpaid sabbatical leave
·       Educational Resources - Career & Personal Development Program
·       Various discount programs (i.e. travel, virtual exercises classes, etc.)
·       We are a merit-based company with many opportunities to learn, excel and grow your career!

align teams, challenge constructively, and drive decisions.</li> </ul> <p>You’ll succeed in this role if you are:</p> <ul> <li>A strategic operator: you can design the system and also roll up your As a Senior Veterinary Surgeon, you’ll work collaboratively with the wider team to deliver a high standard of patient and client care across a varied and rewarding caseload.

We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources.

At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

Fyrnwy Equine Hospital is a well-established 18 vet practice with a Tier 3 equine hospital and ambulatory branch, covering Shropshire, Cheshire and North Wales. The practice consists of European boarded specialists in surgery and medicine, as well as 2 equine nurses, 1 student vet nurse and 11 support staff members. As a practice we manage a mix of National Hunt Thoroughbred studs and Sports horse clients as well as some individual breeders.
 
 
How You’ll Make a Difference 
 
 
As Director of Practice, you will have overall accountability for the performance, strategy, and culture of one or more veterinary practices or hospitals, balancing clinical excellence with strong operational and commercial outcomes. 
 
You’ll lead both clinical and non-clinical teams, set the strategic direction of the practice(s), and ensure the delivery of outstanding patient and client care alongside sustainable business performance. Working closely with regional and group leadership, you’ll drive continuous improvement across clinical standards, people development, financial performance, and ways of working. 
 
*Lead the creation and delivery of the annual business plan, driving sustainable growth while engaging the wider team to contribute ideas, provide feedback, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
*Monitor, analyse, and communicate both practice and individual performance, actively sharing best practice and contributing to the overall success of the wider area.
*Ensure outstanding clinical outcomes by maintaining full compliance with regulatory and governance requirements, while promoting and embedding high clinical standards across all sites.
*Foster a culture of continuous improvement through regular development discussions, performance management, and ongoing team support.
*Champion an exceptional client experience by driving client engagement, promoting service excellence, and ensuring high standards are delivered consistently in every interaction.
*Build and maintain an engaged, high-performing team culture, ensuring appropriate resourcing, supporting staff development, and maintaining a safe, compliant working environment.
*Take full accountability for the financial performance of the practice, including management of the P&L, delivering against budgets, and meeting all financial management requirements .
*Role is full time 40 hours per week - 5 days over 7
 
You Might Be a Great Fit If... 
 
 
You are a highly experienced veterinary leader with strong clinical credibility and proven operational and strategic leadership capability. You’ll bring: 
 
* Proven leadership experience with accountability for clinical, operational, and commercial performance 
* Strong financial and operational understanding, including experience with business planning and P&L management 
* The ability to lead, develop, and inspire multidisciplinary teams through change and growth 
* Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills 
 
 
How We’ll Support You 
 
At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting you in a senior leadership role. When you join us, you’ll benefit from: 
 
* Overall leadership of one or more practices or hospitals, with the autonomy to shape strategy and culture 
* Senior-level influence across clinical standards, operations, and commercial performance 
* Opportunities to lead large-scale change and drive long-term organisational impact 
* Funded learning and development, including access to inspiring vet care Academy training centres and senior leadership programmes 
* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities into wider executive or group leadership roles 
 
 
What We Offer Our Team 
 
*6.6 weeks’ holiday including bank holidays 
*Private medical insurance 
*Enhanced family leave and pay across maternity, paternity, adoption and surrogacy
*Pension scheme 
*Cycle to Work and Green Car schemes (eligibility applies)
*Retail discounts and cashback offers
*Reduced-cost veterinary care for your own pets  

We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources. 
 
Whether you’re just starting out or looking to take the next step in your career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow.

The Operations Director will lead the operational strategy for Pet Drugs Online, focusing on the provision of excellent customer service, regulatory compliance, the delivery of an increasingly efficient operation. This role requires a strategic leader with a deep understanding of e-commerce logistical and customer operations and ideally the pet healthcare market.

Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities: 

As Operations Director, you will have end-to-end responsibility for our operational functions, ensuring they are efficient, scalable, and aligned with our ambitious growth plans. Your leadership will be crucial in optimizing performance, maintaining regulatory compliance, and enhancing customer satisfaction.

Customer Contact Centre Operations
* Lead and develop a high-performing customer service team, ensuring fast response times and high customer satisfaction.
* Implement technologies and processes to improve first-contact resolution and overall service quality.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as response time, customer retention, and Net Promoter Score (NPS).
* Develop training programs and quality assurance processes to maintain excellent customer interactions.

Warehouse & Fulfilment Operations
* Oversee inventory management and ensure accurate stock levels to meet demand efficiently.
* Implement process improvements and automation to enhance order fulfilment speed and accuracy.
* Optimise warehouse layout, picking, packing, and shipping processes to reduce operational costs and errors.
* Ensure compliance with storage and handling requirements, particularly for prescription medicines.

Regulated Prescription Processing
* Ensure strict adherence to regulations governing the handling, verification, and dispatch of pet prescription medicines.
* Collaborate with veterinary professional colleagues to maintain best-in-class compliance.
* Implement robust checks and automated systems to minimise processing errors and regulatory risks.
* Stay up to date with legislative changes, ensuring operations adapt accordingly.

Logistics & Delivery Management
* Manage and optimise partnerships with third-party logistics providers and couriers.
* Negotiate contracts and service level agreements (SLAs) to improve delivery speed and reduce costs.
* Implement tracking and reporting systems to monitor delivery performance and minimise delays.
* Develop contingency plans for seasonal demand spikes, disruptions, and peak trading periods.

Courier & Carrier Relationships
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with multiple courier providers to ensure reliable and cost-effective shipping solutions.
* Monitor courier performance, renegotiate terms where necessary, and drive continuous improvement in delivery times and success rates.
* Explore alternative last-mile delivery options to enhance customer experience and service coverage.

Building Maintenance & Facilities Management
* Ensure the smooth operation and maintenance of warehouse and office facilities.
* Oversee building security, utilities, and workplace safety standards.
* Plan for future expansion needs, ensuring facilities can scale with the company’s growth.
* Manage budgets and negotiate contracts for outsourced maintenance services.

Health & Safety Compliance
* Implement and maintain workplace health and safety policies in line with legal requirements.
* Conduct risk assessments and training to promote a culture of safety among employees.
* Ensure compliance with regulations related to handling, storage, and transportation of prescription medicines and pet food.
* Regularly review and update emergency response plans and safety procedures.

Operational Efficiency & Continuous Improvement
* Identify bottlenecks and implement strategies to enhance efficiency across all operations.
* Leverage technology, automation, and data analytics to streamline processes and reduce costs.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging innovation and best practices.
* Develop and monitor key operational KPIs, reporting to the MD and senior leadership team on performance trends and improvement initiatives.

Leadership & Team Development
* Lead, mentor, and develop operational teams, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Foster a high-performance culture, promoting accountability and continuous learning.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align operations with marketing, sales, and product strategy.
* Build succession planning and talent development programs to strengthen leadership within the operations function.

Essential:
* Proven experience in a senior operational leadership role within e-commerce, retail, logistics, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in customer service, warehousing, logistics, and compliance-driven operations.
* A track record of improving operational efficiency, driving cost savings, and enhancing customer experience.
* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills.
* Experience working in a regulated industry, ideally with prescription medicines, is a plus.
* Data-driven mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and innovation

Desirable:
* Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field; MBA preferred.
* Proficiency in e-commerce WMS and automation opportunities
* Strong interpersonal skills with a confident, enthusiastic approach and a can-do attitude
* Experience of building sound business cases to support business objectives
* Able to prioritise and deliver complex projects and self-motivate, whilst working to strict deadlines and targets.

At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

We are seeking a Director of Practice & Clinical Services to join Sheriffs Highway Vets in Gateshead on a fixed-term basis for 8–9 months to cover maternity leave. * Established four-site small animal practice (Gateshead, Sunderland, Ryton, Whickham)

* Modern diagnostic and surgical facilities including Doppler ultrasound, ECG, digital radiography, dental x-ray, endoscopy, laparoscopy, orthopaedic surgery suite, and in-house laboratory
* Wide and varied first opinion caseload across multiple branches
* Strong support for certificate development and clinical interests across the team

You’ll continue to develop your clinical skills and interests while sharing your knowledge and experience with colleagues, contributing positively to the clinical culture of the practice. You’ll be an integral member of the clinical team, delivering excellent care and supporting the ongoing development of those around you.

raw.title: Director of Equine Surgery
raw.description:
Donnington Grove Veterinary Group is seeking an exceptional equine surgeon to join our senior leadership team as Director of Equine Surgery. This is a rare opportunity to shape and lead a progressive, referral-level surgical service within a highly regarded veterinary group at the heart of Berkshire’s equine community.

 

This role is ideal for a highly experienced board-certified equine surgeon (ACVS/ECVS) with a strong referral caseload background who is driven to deliver clinical excellence, inspire teams and influence the future of equine surgical care.

 

Based in Newbury, Donnington Grove Veterinary Group has a long-standing reputation for delivering high-quality, client-focused veterinary care. Our equine division supports a diverse caseload, from elite competition and racehorses to leisure and breeding horses, through a combination of ambulatory services, advanced diagnostics, hospitalisation and surgical care.

 

At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

 

 

How You’ll Make a Difference

 

As the Director of Equine Surgery, you will lead the continued development of a busy and diverse equine surgical service, combining clinical expertise with strategic leadership. The role provides exposure to a comprehensive range of both soft tissue and orthopaedic surgeries in an elective and emergency setting.

The hospital services a broad client base, including sports horse, Thoroughbred racing, breeding and leisure sectors, and you will play a key role in advancing both clinical standards and client service. Our caseload spans:

 

* Elective and emergency soft tissue surgery
* Orthopaedic and fracture repair
* Arthroscopy and minimally invasive procedures
* Upper airway surgery
* Laparotomy and colic surgery
* Wound reconstruction and advanced diagnostics

 

Working closely with a broad client base, including sports horse, racing, breeding and leisure sectors, you will play a key role in advancing both clinical standards and client service.

 


Key Responsibilities

 

* Provide clinical and strategic leadership for the equine surgery department
* Deliver high-quality elective and emergency surgical procedures
* Drive service growth, innovation and clinical excellence
* Mentor and develop residents, interns and nursing staff
* Foster a positive, collaborative and high-performing team culture
* Build and strengthen relationships with referring vets and clients
* Lead clinical governance, audit and quality improvement initiatives
* Contribute to business planning and operational decision-making
* Represent the practice within the wider equine industry

 


You Might Be a Great Fit If...

 

You are a senior veterinary leader with a strong track record of clinical excellence and strategic leadership. You’ll bring:

 


* Board-certified in equine surgery (ECVS and/or ACVS)
* Strong referral-level caseload experience
* Expertise across orthopaedic, soft tissue and emergency procedures
* Proven leadership and team development skills
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement
* Commercial awareness and strategic mindset

 


How We’ll Support You

 
At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting you in a senior clinical leadership role. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:


* The opportunity to shape and lead clinical strategy across a large practice, hospital, or group of services
* Senior-level influence over clinical standards, governance, and service development
* Support to further develop strategic leadership, change management, and organisational impact
* Funded learning and development including CPD allowance and access to IVC academy training centres & role-relevant courses
* £1,250 annual Care Fund for every vet
* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities into wider senior or executive leadership roles
* A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, innovation, and continuous improvement

 

What We Offer Our Team

* 6.8 weeks’ holiday including bank holidays
* Private medical insurance
* Enhanced family leave and pay across maternity, paternity, adoption and surrogacy
* BVA membership, VDS cover & RCVS fees
* Cycle to Work and Green Car schemes (eligibility applies)
* Retail discounts and cashback offers
* Reduced-cost veterinary care for your own pets

 


We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources.

 


Whether you’re just starting out or looking to take the next step in your career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow.

raw.description:
Clinical Director – Equine Only Practice (Highlands)

Salary up to £80,000 DOE, Relocation Allowance up to £5,000 & Welcome Bonus up to £5,000.
 
At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK's number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.
 
This is more than a leadership appointment. It's an opportunity to shape the future of equine veterinary care in one of the UK's most unique regions.
 

A Rare Leadership Opportunity in the Highlands

 
Kessock Equine Vets is the only dedicated equine practice in the Highlands, delivering a highly respected 24/7 ambulatory and emergency service to a loyal and diverse client base.
 
With strong foundations, an excellent reputation and a committed clinical team, the practice is well positioned for its next chapter. We're looking for an experienced equine vet ready to step into a Clinical Director role, taking ownership of clinical standards, team development and the future direction of the practice.
 
This is a role for someone seeking more than management. It's an opportunity to influence strategy, lead clinical excellence and leave a lasting impact on the practice and the wider equine community.
 

Practice Highlights

 
* The only equine-exclusive practice in the Scottish Highlands
* A genuinely hands-on leadership role within a close-knit, experienced team
* Diverse ambulatory and emergency equine caseload
* Opportunity to shape clinical standards, service development and future investment
* Culture built on trust, autonomy and clinical excellence
* Flexible balance of leadership and clinical responsibilities
* Outstanding lifestyle location with access to mountains, coastline and outdoor living
 

How You'll Make a Difference

 
As Clinical Director (Director of Practice & Clinical Services), you will lead the clinical and strategic direction of the practice, working closely with the Practice Manager to deliver outstanding patient care, develop a high-performing team and support sustainable practice growth.
 
You'll play a highly visible leadership role, helping shape the future of the practice while maintaining an active clinical caseload aligned with your interests and expertise.
 

Working Pattern

* Up to 40 hours per week
* 1 in 4.5 out-of-hours weekends
 

Key Responsibilities

* Lead clinical governance, standards and decision-making across the practice
* Develop clinical protocols, patient pathways and quality improvement initiatives
* Mentor and support a small, highly engaged veterinary team
* Work collaboratively on operational performance, workforce planning and long-term sustainability
* Drive service development, investment priorities and strategic growth
* Act as a senior clinical ambassador for clients and referring practices
* Maintain an active clinical caseload aligned with your interests and strengths
* Participate in the shared out-of-hours rota
 

Lifestyle & Location

 
Based in Inverness, the gateway to the Scottish Highlands, this role offers a rare combination of senior clinical leadership and an exceptional quality of life.
 
If you value space, spectacular landscapes and outdoor living alongside a rewarding veterinary career, this is a unique opportunity to enjoy both.
 

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

 
You are a senior clinical leader with strong equine expertise, commercial awareness and a passion for developing people and services. You'll bring:
 
* Significant experience as an Equine Veterinary Surgeon, ideally with advanced qualifications such as CertAVP or equivalent
* Proven leadership experience with responsibility for supporting and developing veterinary teams
* Strong commercial and financial awareness with an interest in practice performance and sustainability
* The ability to engage, motivate and develop high-performing teams
* Experience contributing to clinical governance, audit and continuous improvement initiatives
* Excellent communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills
* A collaborative, values-led leadership style with a commitment to exceptional patient and client care
 

How We'll Support You

 
At inspiring vet care, we're committed to supporting you in a senior clinical leadership role. When you join us, you'll benefit from:
 
* A senior leadership position with genuine autonomy and influence over the future direction of the practice
* Clear career pathways into wider clinical and operational leadership opportunities
* Ongoing leadership development and access to the inspiring vet care Academy
* A collaborative, values-led culture focused on clinical excellence, innovation and continuous improvement
 

What We Offer Our Team

 
* 6.8 weeks' holiday including bank holidays
* Private medical insurance
* Enhanced family leave and pay across maternity, paternity, adoption and surrogacy
* BEVA membership, VDS cover and RCVS fees
* Cycle to Work and Green Car schemes (eligibility applies)
* Retail discounts and cashback offers
* Reduced-cost veterinary care for your own pets
 
We're committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources.
 
Whether you're looking to shape the future of an established equine practice or take the next step in your leadership career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Ready to revolutionize healthcare, making it faster and more accessible than ever before?&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>How we started:</strong></span></p> <p>Founded in 2013 by Dwayne D’Souza,&nbsp;HeliosX<em>&nbsp;</em>was built on a simple but powerful idea: healthcare should be easier to access, faster to receive, and centred around the individual. From day one, we’ve grown without external funding; scaling profitably through technology, disciplined execution, and deep medical expertise. What started as a challenger idea has become one of the most significant healthcare platforms operating globally today.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Where we are now:</strong></span></p> <p>We’ve earned the trust of millions of people worldwide through category-leading products and well-known brands, including MedExpress, Dermatica, ZipHealth, RocketRX, and Levity. A key driver of our success is vertical integration; we operate our own manufacturing and proprietary products, led by in-house medical teams, researchers, and pharmacists at the top of their fields.</p> <p>In 2025, HeliosX treated more than 1.7 million patients globally and reached £781m in revenue, representing +337% year-on-year growth and cementing our position as the clear market leader in the UK. That growth translates into real-world outcomes: our weight-loss treatments helped patients lose 8.5 million kilograms of excess weight in 2025 alone, contributing to an estimated 1,300 fewer cardiac events. This is growth with measurable, life-changing impact at scale.</p> <p>Today, we operate across four international markets, with successful launches in Germany and Canada and continued expansion in the US. We were also recently recognised in the Sunday Times Top 100 fastest-growing tech companies, further validation of both our momentum and our ambition.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Where we’re going:</strong></span></p> <p>2026 is a step-change year. Our ambition is to reach £1.6bn in revenue, expand from four to eight global markets and significantly broaden our condition and treatment portfolio. Over the coming years, you’ll help shape HeliosX into a truly world-leading healthcare partner; one that combines scale, speed, and clinical rigour to redefine how personalised care is delivered. Joining HeliosX now means building systems, teams, and products that will define the next decade of digital healthcare, and doing work that genuinely improves lives, at global scale.</p> <p><strong>There’s never been a more exciting time to join HeliosX. Prima could be the place for you.  Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. In 2025, Prima became part of the AXA Group, enabling us to further realize our potential through global expertise. Our core ambition remains market leadership through advanced technology, outstanding people, and an exceptional customer experience. To help fuel that growth, we need a Principal Technical & Complex Claims Leader to join our Claims UK team to help us build the future of Motor Claims Management in the UK. Reporting directly to the UK Head of Claims, you will play a pivotal role in building our tech-enabled Motor Claims function in Manchester as we transition from a TPA to an internalized model. This strategic, non-BAU role requires an entrepreneurial business-builder to define our Complex Claims philosophy, drive portfolio financial performance, and pioneer advanced tech integration. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details What you'll do Functional Design & Build Work with the Head of Claims UK to design, direct, and execute the internalisation strategy for Technical & Complex Claims; lead the transformation agenda across the Technical & Complex Claims set of domains as we internalise. Build and lead a capable team of high-calibre Technical Claims Specialists across High-Value Claims, Large Loss, Complex Bodily Injury, and Third-Party Property Damage / Credit Hire. As we internalise and scale the overall functions, this role will lead a team of Managers responsible for each of these individuals domains of in-function expertise. Establish strong processes across Technical Claims to ensure case strategies are effective, proactive, and focused on commercially-aware settlement. Technical Claims Leadership Act as the ultimate point of authority on Technical Claims topics, providing evidence-based advice and recommendations on case strategies, technical referrals, and other areas of relevant subject matter expertise. Hold joint accountability (with the Head of Claims UK) for financial performance of the Complex & Technical Claims portfolio; define and embed our reserving philosophy, proactively manage indemnity spend, minimise leakage, and directly influence the firm’s Loss Ratio performance. Complex Claims / Referrals Management:  Act as a senior point of escalation for Claims exceeding individual specialist handlers’ authority limits; ensure that key case decisions are effective, facts-based, and well-considered. Review and challenge Complex Claims case strategies, detailed reserving calculations, litigation approaches, and high-value settlements. Maintain excellent relationships with key Company stakeholders as well as stakeholders across our Capacity / Reinsurance Partners, in regard to the management of Complex Claims. Tech-enabling Domain Expertise:  Serve as the lead SME to Product and Engineering colleagues as we build a market-leading proprietary Claims Management Platform. Support in translating expertise and experience / Technical Claims logic into easy-to-understand business requirements and user needs. Work closely with our Claims Business Architect to design and embed well-structured and effective Technical Claims processes. What we’re looking for Senior Leadership : 10+ years of senior leadership experience within the UK Motor Insurance market, either at a large UK insurer, MGA, or InsurTech. Transofrmation Experience : Demonstrated experience of leading major claims transformation activity, with a proven track record of designing, scaling and/or restructuring Complex Claims functions. Financial Acumen : Deep expertise in managing multi-million pound Complex Claims portfolios; proven ability to set reserving philosophies, establish appropriate authority limits, and manage the financial levers that drive Loss Ratio performance. Subject Matter Expertise : Advanced knowledge of all areas of Complex Claims, including Large Loss, Complex Bodily Injury, Credit Hire indemnity strategy, Case Law, Litigation Management. Entrepreneurial Approach : Demonstrably “can-do” mindset; able to effectively operate within a fast-paced MGA environment. Tech-forward Mindset : Strong strategic grasp of how advanced technology (including AI, Machine Learning, and Advanced Data Science) can be used to disrupt and reinvent traditional claims handling processes for the better. People Leadership / Gravitas : Proven ability to lead and inspire a team of ambitious Domain Managers, and Technical Claims Specialists. Cross-functional Influence : Highly adept at working transversally across different functional areas to drive collaboration and ensure effective progress.  Technology Ways of Working : Extensive experience of working with / alongside software engineers, product managers, and UX designers; knowledge of UK Claims Management platforms. 🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you. 🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support. Think you’re a match? Apply now.   At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. title: SVP, Data & Tech Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>2830 - SVP, Data &amp; Tech Lead - GCS</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p><em>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. WPP Media is WPP's global media collective, bringing together the best platforms, people, and partners to create limitless opportunities for growth in a world where media is Everywhere.&nbsp; </em></p> <p>This role is within the Data, Tech, and Analytics (DTA) team, within the Global Client Solutions organisation. The Global Client Solutions (GCS) team is responsible for all global clients within WPP. DTA is responsible for servicing clients with best-in-class data solutions, data strategy, analytics, technology and AI solutions to drive client growth. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection.</p> <p><strong>SVP, Data &amp; Tech Lead</strong></p> <p>As the Global Client Data &amp; Tech Lead, you will take ownership of driving data-led transformation for one of WPP’s largest and most ambitious global clients. You will be at the forefront of enabling data, technology, and AI to create more impactful brand experiences and measurable business growth.</p> <p>You will be a strategic partner to WPP Media’s Global Client Leads, defining what ‘data-driven’ marketing looks like for your client across Discovery, Planning, Activation, and Measurement. You will act as a senior advisor to CMOs and other key stakeholders and will guide them in building the data capabilities and infrastructure needed to achieve their marketing goals while ensuring responsible and effective use of data.</p> <p>This role demands a leader who can combine thought leadership, operational expertise, strong line management, and a deep understanding of data and technology to deliver tangible results. You will assemble and lead a team of experts to implement strategies, deploy solutions, and build long-term capability for your client.</p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own Client Data Narrative &amp; Drive Growth:</strong> Build strategic relationships with key client stakeholders, including CMOs, IT, and Finance leaders. Develop a deep understanding of client objectives and advise on how data, technology, and AI can drive impact and growth. Act as a trusted advisor, helping clients navigate complex challenges and opportunities in data-driven marketing. Partner with the Global Account Director/Client President to co-create and execute the Global Client Growth Plan.</li> <li><strong>Data Strategy Expertise:</strong> Assemble and lead a team of data strategists to define the role of data for media and advertising on the client business. Define how first-party data should be collected, organized, and deployed across business units. Identify and execute data partnerships to enrich and extend first-party data. Standardize data usage across markets and business units to achieve marketing objectives.</li> <li><strong>Measurement &amp; Optimization Frameworks:</strong> Oversee the design and implementation of measurement frameworks that balance short- and long-term value creation. Define growth targets and metrics for marketing effectiveness. Define and deploy use of data science techniques to better predict growth from audience-based, omnichannel approaches. Introduce AI-powered optimization tools to enhance efficiency and performance within and across channels. Ensure timely and actionable reporting for visibility into performance.</li> <li><strong>Technology Consulting and Implementation</strong>: Assemble and lead a team to evaluate clients’ technology ecosystems and recommend improvements to enhance performance and reduce costs. Oversee the implementation of cloud data management, martech, adtech, AI, and analytics systems. Integrate WPP Data, Tech, and media solutions into the client’s broader technology stack to accelerate results.</li> <li><strong>Capability Building and Education</strong>: Educate WPP client teams on WPP’s data capabilities, tools, and priorities. Provide visible leadership, coaching, and mentorship to inspire teams and foster innovation in data, technology, and AI.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL NEED</strong></p> <ul> <li>Relevant industry experience, including significant time in an agency environment.</li> <li>Proven experience operating at a senior client leadership level or engaging with high-profile stakeholders.</li> <li>Demonstrated thought leadership and expertise in data, technology, and AI within the marketing industry.</li> <li>A track record of solving complex problems and delivering measurable business success through data-driven strategies.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence teams, clients, and colleagues positively.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills, capable of simplifying complex concepts for diverse audiences.</li> <li>Experience building and managing large, diverse teams of data, technology, and analytics specialists.</li> <li>Strategic and operational agility, with the ability to adapt quickly in dynamic environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to&nbsp;Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also&nbsp;Lead Optimistically,&nbsp;firmly believing&nbsp;in and&nbsp;Championing Growth and Development&nbsp;for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to&nbsp;leverage&nbsp;the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the&nbsp;cutting edge&nbsp;of marketing and advertising.&nbsp;</p> <p>We&nbsp;Create an Open environment&nbsp;built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events&nbsp;showcasing&nbsp;team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when&nbsp;we're&nbsp;together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment.&nbsp;That's&nbsp;why&nbsp;we’ve&nbsp;adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you&nbsp;require&nbsp;accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.&nbsp; Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.</p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</em></p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We are our clients’ key contacts for a unified view across all aspects of their campaigns.</p> <p><strong>Position Summary:</strong></p> <p>The Business Director will oversee media campaigns with support from more junior planners and assist the Client Lead in ensuring our work is delivered to the highest quality. They are responsible for ensuring investment is optimal to deliver campaign objectives, via effective planning.</p> <p><strong>Our clients:</strong></p> <p>We work across the EE/BT group.&nbsp; Although their public faces are very different, the two brands are managed very closely together.&nbsp; They’re one of the nation’s biggest spenders, and some of our most-loved brands.&nbsp; They are genuinely important to the nation with their creation and management of the UK’s connectivity networks, and we reflect that importance with how we try to help consumers and give them useful solutions in a modern world.</p> <p><strong>Our team:</strong></p> <p>Team Connect is a very big team that is 100% allocated to EE, BT and Plusnet.&nbsp; A successful candidate can expect to work on multiple aspects of these brands. This includes broadband, mobile, TV, as well as Masterbrand. This role is purely Brand focused but will involve close collaboration with Performance planners.</p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience:</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>Essential Functions/Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain fantastic relationships with key clients in media and marketing teams.</li> <li>Ensure the delivery of high-quality response presentations, actionable weekly reporting, insightful post campaign analyses and clear briefs to Activation.</li> <li>Deliver clear and compelling rationale to support media investment recommendations and to evidence campaign performance versus expected outcomes.</li> <li>Spearhead the integration of data analytics and insights into the core of our strategic planning processes, ensuring data is used proactively and upfront in all client engagements and internal initiatives.</li> <li>Accelerate AI adoption and transformation across the team, ensuring we are regularly sharing work and that clients see the tangible benefits of WPP Open.</li> <li>Take a lead role in developing and presenting best-in-class Strategic Response to Briefs (RTBs).</li> <li>Support ADs in delivering Media Detail RTBs and in briefing Activation teams.</li> <li>Work closely with the Head of Strategy &amp; (internal teams, clients, senior leadership).</li> <li>Highly collaborative, comfortable working cross-functionally with data, analytics, research, and creative teams.</li> <li>Proven track record of leading, inspiring, and upskilling more junior planners, fostering a culture of curiosity and continuous learning.</li> <li>Excellent organisational skills, close attention to detail and ability to quality-control work.</li> <li>Forecast expected outcomes of brand and performance campaigns and manage investment accordingly.</li> <li>Basic spreadsheet capabilities (VLOOKUP, Pivot Table) are a must.</li> <li>Superior presentation design skills, in slides or document format.</li> <li>Ability to adhere to deadlines and project manage multiple campaigns.</li> <li>Development and maintenance of productive relationships with media owner partners.</li> <li>Proven problem solving and decision-making skills.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and to collaborate in a team environment.</li> <li>Skilled in quantitative reasoning.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Management Responsibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Motivate a team, leading by example while coaching juniors - cultivating a dynamic and inquisitive culture where hypothesis-driven thinking is central to problem-solving.</li> <li>Provide timely and actionable feedback to aid in team development and improvement.</li> <li>Monitor and support satisfaction across the team, identifying and implementing ways to maintain or increase satisfaction.</li> <li>Foster strong working relationships across the team to facilitate flawless execution of plans.</li> <li>Communicate effectively across all levels of the team, understanding when to escalate issues to leadership.</li> <li>Calculate the workload implication of new campaigns and feed into resource management.</li> <li>Provide awareness and recognition for jobs well done.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Education and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>At least six to eight years of experience in a pure planning role.</li> <li>Demonstrable interest and expertise in planning craft.</li> <li>Data literate with demonstrable expertise in understanding, interpreting, and applying various data sources.</li> <li>Mastery of planning/insight tools such as eTelmar, TGI, YouGov, WARC, etc.</li> <li>Strong experience and interest in dedicated planning tools.</li> <li>Interest and knowledge of Planning and Media trends and issues.</li> <li>Proven experience in media at Senior Manager level.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically,&nbsp;firmly believing&nbsp;in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to&nbsp;leverage&nbsp;the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the&nbsp;cutting edge&nbsp;of marketing and advertising.&nbsp;</p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.&nbsp;</p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location.</p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy</a>) for more information on how we process the information you provide.&nbsp;</p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
